VERIFICATION LOG — EVIDENCE
### 2026-10-01 — worker — activated

Selected the bounded register-handoff optimization after the prior clock
investigation rejected its candidates. Source inspection finds a 31-word scan
in `XRegs::jit_commit_words_mask`; compiled FP commits already use sparse bit
iteration. Work is isolated in the `emulator-speed-next` worktree; unrelated
edits in the user's original checkout are preserved.

### 2026-10-01 — worker — candidate selection (negative)

Six implementations were screened. Sparse iteration alone regressed full masks;
a full-copy special case regressed near-full masks; a threshold with an iterator
scan regressed mixed masks. Preserving the fixed-slice scan removed those large
regressions. The empty/full-only variant and the final inlining variant still
failed the repeated >1.02x sparse gate. The latter reached 1.0200539197x in its
screen, then only 1.0138260311x at frozen head `29980ba5`. No threshold was lowered.

Production `jit_commit_words_mask` is restored to parent `ec178d57`. Only tests,
the benchmark harness, measured evidence and demo documentation will remain.
No faster browser/Omarchy/boot behavior is claimed. Exact worker submission and
fresh-verifier verdict follow after restored-head gates and publication.

### 2026-10-01 — worker — restored-head submission (implemented)

Claim: this is a measured negative investigation. Six candidate implementations
were rejected; **no runtime optimization or emulator speedup is retained**. At
`26f63873d0a005be19ef2c7c682cfee96907de27`, the production part of `regs.rs`
is identical to parent `ec178d57`, and the entire shipped wasm package has no diff.
The rebuilt wasm SHA-256 is
`f8b40d93039a9bb454250df40592e8c1d62144cac600bdcd82ea74098d7bb516`,
also the original main `0a5f7bd7` artifact. Commit `a3afda72` changes only native
benchmark JSON word formatting and documentation; its narrow clean-clone proof
is recorded separately. No production or browser-harness semantics changed.

Evidence index: `evidence/omarchy-profile/sparse-handoff-final/selection.json`
links the seven decisive recordings of six implementations, their source,
harness and wasm digests. Saved historical sources reproduce each uncommitted
experiment exactly. The final inlining candidate's repeated source/artifact was
identical across 1.0200539197x and 1.0138260311x sparse results; the second fails
the unchanged >1.02x retain gate. Earlier near-dense regressions also fail. The
first bulk-copy candidate's BusyBox run is historical rejected-candidate evidence,
not a measurement of the restored final runtime. Its first sample in each arm
logged one generic 404; it is not cited as zero-error demo proof.

Commands and final results (all local on this Mac; rr/ssh-dev waived):

- `make verify-E5.5-T03be`: strict affected clippy/fmt, native and wasm fixtures,
  browser-executor parity and FP comparisons; 50 passed, one pre-existing ignored.
- `cargo test -p wasm-vm-core --features trace -- --skip core_has_no_stdout_macros`:
  1,098 passed, 11 existing ignored across 131 binaries/doc-test runs. The skipped
  test was run separately and its pre-existing failure preserved, not suppressed.
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Users/blamy/Documents/Codex/wasm-vm/target cargo test -p wasm-vm-jit-runtime --lib --test jit_execution --test precise_traps --test verifier_jitcov_r1`:
  34 passed. The shared target directory only reuses compiled dependencies.
- `wasm-pack test --node crates/wasm --test jit_sparse_handoff -- --nocapture`:
  three passed; `guest-evidence.log` records 40 instruction hashes/full snapshot
  digests across bounded resumes, and real compiled-block counts. Independent
  10,598-mask and verifier 5,952-case oracles both pass native and wasm.
- `make web-dist`: production wasm rebuilt and proven byte-identical to baseline.
- Pristine clone with `RUSTFLAGS`, `CARGO_*`, `RUST_LOG` and wrappers scrubbed:
  `make verify-E5.5-T03be` exits zero, starts clean and ends with no tracked diff.
  `cold-clone.json` names the exact clone/head. The later hex-word output change
  passes narrow fmt/clippy/build and 256 exact-u64 JSON checks there as well.
- `make ci` was attempted: existing macOS build failure in Linux-only wvseccomp.
  `cargo test -p wasm-vm-core --test no_stdout_in_core` also fails on existing GPU
  eprintln usage. Both reproduce on untouched main `0a5f7bd7`; see the retained
  baseline logs and `final/limitations.json`. This is not a full-gauntlet pass.
- The final identical-wasm control passes state checks and records
  `identicalBrowserBinary=true`, `acceptanceHeld=false`. It ran alongside checks;
  its timings are not used as speed evidence. Historic native word previews used
  JSON numbers, but Rust asserted exact u64 values before printing. The retained
  producer now emits lossless hex strings; exact-word recordings cover all masks.

The fresh verifier independently added the composition attack and sabotage
recording. It also ran the bounded-resume and precise-fault fixtures in actual
Chrome 154.0.8037.93: 41 passed, one existing ignored, zero page errors; see
`evidence/omarchy-profile/sparse-handoff-verifier-r1/chrome-fixtures.json`.

Browser/demo: `E5_DEMO_TASK=E5.5-T03be E5_DEMO_OUT=evidence/omarchy-profile/sparse-handoff-final/demo-local node tools/verify/e5-t18e-demo-smoke.mjs`
ran one built-page suite: **127 passed, 0 failed**, zero console/HTTP errors. The
negative-result task is visible; the legacy bulk-handoff capability remains
verified and its evidence text states no additional speedup. Screenshot inspected.
The Playwright MCP was unavailable; the repository's local Playwright runner was
used. `bash tools/deploy-cloudflare.sh` published the same bytes at
<https://b32052cc.wasm-vm.pages.dev> and <https://wasm-vm.pages.dev>.
`final/publication.json` matches served wasm, roadmap and task inventory bytes to
the committed dist. Deployment staging rewrites were restored after publication.
The verifier's final status will be reflected in one final metadata publication.

Final worker files are sealed by `sparse-handoff-final/SHA256SUMS`. Verifier
evidence has its own recorded digests. `frozen-artifacts.json`, `test-summary.json`,
`cold-clone.json`, raw reports and logs distinguish deterministic correctness,
benchmark eligibility and host limitations. No PR merge is requested or performed.

### 2026-10-01 — verifier — VERDICT: verified

Verified as a **negative investigation**, with no retained optimization or speedup
claim. Fresh-session predictions preceded evidence inspection. Full verdict and
hunk coverage: `evidence/omarchy-profile/sparse-handoff-verifier-r1/VERDICT.md`;
the directory's `SHA256SUMS` seals the critic's recordings.

- P0/P5 — HELD: independently recounted all decisive raw pairs and checked saved
  source/harness/report hashes. The final candidate's identical-source/wasm repeat
  is 1.0138260311x, below the unchanged >1.02 gate. Production source and shipped
  wasm are restored to main/parent, SHA-256 `f8b40d93039a9bb454250df40592e8c1d62144cac600bdcd82ea74098d7bb516`.
- P1/P2/P8 — HELD: the 10,598-mask oracle and promoted 5,952-case rotated/complement
  attack pass native, wasm and Chrome; independent Python digests match both.
  Commit `26f63873` promotes same-value stamp, poisoned-x0 and rotating-hole checks.
  Scratch bit31 sabotage fails with x31=0 instead of `u64::MAX`; product bytes are
  unchanged (`sabotage-drop-bit31.log:7-10`).
- P3/P4 — HELD: independently reconstructed all 40 guest ADDI/JAL hashes; Chrome
  and Node trace/snapshot lines are identical. Real Chrome fixtures pass 41 tests,
  with one pre-existing ignored long churn case and zero page errors. Precise
  load-fault prefix assertions pass (`chrome-jit_browser_parity.txt:12`).
- P6/P7 — HELD: sealed logs independently total 50 focused, 1,098 core and 34
  native-JIT passes. The pristine clone is clean at `a3afda72` after the narrow
  lossless-JSON follow-up; its runtime/tests/browser harness are unchanged from
  the full acceptance proof at `26f63873`. Existing macOS seccomp/stdout failures
  remain explicitly qualified; no full-gauntlet pass is claimed. Every final
  executable hunk is exercised or explicitly waived in the coverage table.
- Publication — HELD: independent refetch matches all six immutable/production
  wasm, roadmap and task artifacts to committed bytes. One actual live-deployment
  smoke passes **127/0**, zero relevant console/HTTP errors, with the negative
  task visible. Screenshot digest `e5aac704b5cfcc8c3936a58ebb5d2b1e3b90ab5548d4af188f547cbbbde98c03`.

Commands: narrow native/wasm fixture and strict clippy; scratch sabotage; independent
Python source/median/state/receipt audits; actual Chrome test runner driven by
Playwright; existing demo smoke collector against `https://b32052cc.wasm-vm.pages.dev`.
Final metadata publication may update the visible task status without changing
the proved runtime. PRs remain open.
ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION
A fresh verifier predicts register/stamp values before reading evidence; attack
x0-only, highest register, dense masks, wrap and precise fault prefixes. Compare
recorded guest state to the untouched implementation and inspect each changed
runtime hunk. Independently recount paired benchmark medians, invent one bounded
mask attack, and sabotage-check a new regression. Verify the frozen clone and
served artifact hashes. No runtime edits by the verifier; leave PRs open.
